integrity: The proof starts from the published residue-coset decomposition of total graphs when the zero divisors form an ideal. It independently proves the local-ring size inequality m>=q, computes the full componentwise automorphism group, derives sharp determining lower and upper bounds, and constructs optimal distinguishing labelings. A standalone checker reconstructs representative total graphs directly from modular arithmetic and exhaustively verifies automorphisms and small symmetry-breaking cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite commutative local ring that is not a field.
The graph automorphism group is computed; the image of the ring automorphism group is not classified.
title: Symmetry breaking in total graphs of finite local rings
